Name: Maggs Immersive Sebastian Spicy Expansion Dialogue and Events
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url]!

[b]DISCLAIMER FOR WRITING STYLE
[/b]The dialogue in this mod is written informally and according to common speech patterns, so it is NOT always grammatically correct. Words may be dropped, conjunctions skipped, and improper words used. Formal grammar is not natural speech and sounds forced and flat when used for dialogue.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764217843.png[/img]
This expansion pack adds the spicy and mature (extra spicy) content to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25841]Maggs Immersive Sebastian Romance Core[/url]. This content can be fairly steamy, but is not yandere or crass.
Simply download the Spicy Expansion of your choice, and add it like any other mod to your mods folder. It requires the Core mod to run.
Three download options, choose the one that matches your Core selection.
[list]
[*]Spicy Slow Burn (not poly compatible)[/*]
[*]Spicy Speed Run (not poly compatible)[/*]
[*]Spicy Lite (compatible with PolyamorySweet and any other game structure-changing mod)[/*]
[/list]
Details:
[list]
[*]Make all the same configuration choices in the Spicy expansion that you made in the core. (This will only cause an issue if you choose to disable splash art in the core, but not in the expansion.)[/*]
[*]Includes a Mature option that adds a bit more to the spicy content.[/*]
[*]Slow Burn and Speed Run variants include the Sleepover and Pillowtalk event series. (Not included in Lite due to issues with multi-spouse game changes and different farmhouse structures.)[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764218205.png[/img]
[color=#8e7cc3][size=3][b]Sleepover and Pillowtalk series details (repeatable events are not included in Lite, they have Polyamory conflict issues)[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]First Sleepover Night[/b] Unlocks 2 days after seeing Levitate, Farmhouse, after 9 pm - must leave and enter again if you were already in the house before 9. [color=#00ffff]Must have your farmhouse upgraded to include the kitchen.[/color][/*]
[*][b]First Sleepover Morning [/b]Have seen First Sleepover Night, Farmhouse[/*]
[*][b]Sleepover Night repeatable[/b] Farmhouse, after 9 pm.[/*]
[*][b]Sleepover Morning repeatable[/b] Farmhouse on waking.[/*]
[*][b]Pillowtalk repeatable[/b] Married to Sebastian, Farmhouse, after 9 pm. - must leave and enter again if you were already in the house before 9.[/*]
[/list][b]Looking for help triggering an event?[/b] Find tips here before posting a comment: [url=https://maggplays.com/event-help/]Event Help[/url]
[url=https://maggplays.com/slow-burn-events/]Slow Burn Event Details[/url]: Event IDs, one-line description, trigger conditions.
[url=https://maggplays.com/immersive-sebastian-speed-run-lite-events/]Speed Run/Lite Event Details[/url]: Event IDs, one-line description, trigger conditions.
[url=https://maggplays.com/sebastian-faq/]FAQ/Info[/url]: Go here to find a thorough list of common questions.
